## What does instant coffee jar mean for an Indian kitchen?

If you’ve ever opened an instant coffee jar and wondered what it really means for your kitchen, think of it as a shortcut that still lets you taste the real bean. The ingredient list is the only line that matters. Turn the jar around and look for the word chicory — if it appears, the blend contains it; if it does not, you are holding pure coffee. Choosing from the Purity Beans lineup comes down to how you actually take your coffee.
